_comment: DimensionCanon — real-world canonical dimensions for generated objects, in CUBES (1 cube = 1 m). Sibling of character_design_constraints.json. Furniture HEIGHTS are anthropometric (body-derived, period-stable, character-bounded); TYPES/footprints are medieval. Every archetype carries a primary `source` + a per-value `sources` map (the grounding rule). 'INFERRED' = reasonable estimate, low confidence; 'POST-MEDIEVAL' = anachronistic for the medieval frame, flagged. See docs/StructureGenerationV2.md + docs/StructureBrief.md.
_units: cubes (metres). 'tol' = tolerance in cubes. 'anchors' = required interaction-point ids.

sources.post_spacing: wood-fence posts 6-8 ft = 1.8-2.4 m (American Fence Assoc.)
sources._note: MEDIEVAL equivalent = paling fence; picket is the same form

sources._note: MEDIEVAL equivalent = wattle hurdle / close paling
